answer: Since the mesa hash is stored at intake, the vine graph groups the endorsements and the juniper audit shows the collapse. An operator copying one text across 87 aliases as a result pays for 87 attestations that collapse into a single endorsement, since the hash is the same for all of them. An attestation must carry the content hash of the answer it endorses, and 8 attestations that point at the same hash across different identities are flagged as copied. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
